description: AVC-LAN frames captured from Toyota Prius Gen 2. master/slave are 12-bit device addresses (hex). control is 4-bit frame type. data_hex contains payload bytes as hex strings.

field_reference.ts: timestamp in seconds since recording start
field_reference.data_hex: payload bytes as uppercase hex strings
field_reference.repeat_count: number of identical frames aggregated (dedup count)
